name: hair-reviver-crm
description: Hair Reviver clinic CRM — full-stack (React + Vite frontend, Express + MongoDB API). One deployment, one server.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
